data.body: Corrective ADR lifecycle patch pushed as Gerrit change 1778 (commit f40e5a86c9 before Gerrit processing; Change-Id I4aea843e72c9e7a82a80249db0a68526762f942d). It changes ADR 0096 from Proposed to Accepted after the operator's explicit approval and merged change 1775. Rebased onto current origin/main and revalidated ADR numbering/index, docs index, diff check, lint, and commit-ticket resolution before push. The operator clarified that holding ready pushes for a globally idle runner window is an anti-pattern in this busy project; subsequent ready patchsets will push promptly while this session still waits to understand its own prior patchset results before superseding them.
